verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents a first-party 'BigQuery sandbox' for exploring limited BigQuery capabilities at no cost, without a credit card or billing account. This gives an isolated place to experiment, and Dataform is described as letting analysts develop and test transformation workflows. However, the sandbox is positioned as a free trial tier rather than a dev/test environment isolated from production data. missing for 10: documented dev/test isolation from production datasets (e.g. cloning or masked copies of prod data), agent-oriented sandbox workflows, a full rather than limited feature set in the sandbox, and independent hands-on corroboration.
